# kener_site_config (Data Source)

Reads a single Kener global site-configuration value by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kener_site_config" "title" {
  key = "title"
}

output "site_title" {
  value = jsondecode(data.kener_site_config.title.value)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The site-configuration key to read.

### Read-Only

- `data_type` (String) The value's data type (`string` or `object`).
- `value` (String) The value as JSON.
